info.title: NHEFS + synthetic teaching covariates
info.scope: Unweighted, selected teaching subset. These exploratory associations do not identify causal effects or survey-adjusted national estimates.
info.percentiles: Stata default: average adjacent order statistics at integer N*p; otherwise use ceiling(N*p).
info.rankTest: Normal rank-sum approximation with tie adjustment and no continuity correction.

variables.name: education
variables.label: Education
variables.definition: 1 ≤8th grade; 2 high-school dropout; 3 high school; 4 college dropout; 5 college or more.

variables.name: exercise
variables.label: Exercise
variables.definition: 0 much; 1 moderate; 2 little or none, at baseline.

variables.name: wt82_71
variables.label: Weight change (kg)
variables.definition: Follow-up weight minus baseline weight; missing for 63 original rows.

variables.name: smokeintensity
variables.label: Cigarettes/day
variables.definition: Baseline cigarettes per day; not assumed to follow a Poisson model.

variables.name: cholesterol
variables.label: Cholesterol
variables.definition: Baseline serum cholesterol, mg/100 mL. Variable-specific available n is reported.

variables.name: hf
variables.label: History of heart failure
variables.definition: 0 never; 1 ever diagnosed at baseline. Sparse cells illustrate exact testing.

variables.name: qsmk
variables.label: Smoking cessation
variables.definition: 1 quit smoking by 1982; 0 did not quit.

variables.name: demo_visits
variables.label: Simulated clinic visits
variables.definition: Poisson(2.5); nonnegative integer counts, independently generated.

variables.name: demo_group
variables.label: Simulated group
variables.definition: A/B/C assignment for the synthetic ANOVA example only.

variables.name: demo_score
variables.label: Simulated score
variables.definition: Normal within each group: A mean 20 SD 3; B mean 20 SD 6; C mean 24 SD 10. Arbitrary score units.

variables.name: demo_age_copy
variables.label: Simulated near-duplicate age
variables.definition: age + Normal(0, 0.15²); deliberately near-collinear with age.

factor_clean_ols.formula: regress wt82_71 i.qsmk c.age c.wt71 c.smokeintensity i.sex i.exercise i.education

factor_clean_hc3.formula: regress wt82_71 i.qsmk c.age c.wt71 c.smokeintensity i.sex i.exercise i.education, vce(hc3)

factor_copy_ols.formula: regress wt82_71 i.qsmk c.age c.wt71 c.smokeintensity i.sex i.exercise i.education c.demo_age_copy

factor_copy_hc3.formula: regress wt82_71 i.qsmk c.age c.wt71 c.smokeintensity i.sex i.exercise i.education c.demo_age_copy, vce(hc3)

numeric_clean_ols.formula: regress wt82_71 i.qsmk c.age c.wt71 c.smokeintensity i.sex i.exercise c.education

numeric_clean_hc3.formula: regress wt82_71 i.qsmk c.age c.wt71 c.smokeintensity i.sex i.exercise c.education, vce(hc3)

numeric_copy_ols.formula: regress wt82_71 i.qsmk c.age c.wt71 c.smokeintensity i.sex i.exercise c.education c.demo_age_copy

numeric_copy_hc3.formula: regress wt82_71 i.qsmk c.age c.wt71 c.smokeintensity i.sex i.exercise c.education c.demo_age_copy, vce(hc3)

diagnostics.baselineFormula: regress wt82_71 i.qsmk c.age c.wt71 c.smokeintensity i.sex i.exercise i.education

figures.title: Different variables, different distributions
figures.alt: Histograms from generated values: approximately bell-shaped normal marker, a long right tail for the log-normal marker, and discrete nonnegative visit counts. All three variables are simulated.

figures.title: Explore the outcome and a covariate
figures.alt: Boxplots retain extreme positive and negative weight changes. A scatterplot of change against baseline weight includes a LOWESS descriptive smooth, not a causal effect.

figures.title: Compare the group distributions before ANOVA
figures.alt: Synthetic groups A and B have equal generating means but different spreads; group C has a higher generating mean and the largest spread. Actual displayed values come from seed 602.

figures.title: Check the fitted model
figures.alt: Diagnostics for the categorical-education model without the synthetic age copy. Heavy residual tails and unequal variance deserve attention; the Cook threshold 4/n is a screening heuristic, not an automatic deletion rule.

figures.title: A synthetic covariate that almost duplicates age
figures.alt: The generated covariate is age plus small Gaussian noise and creates severe multicollinearity if entered with age.
